title: Breaking the H2O dissociation-OH desorption scaling relationship in alkaline hydrogen evolution by oxophilic single atom M1–Run electrocatalysts
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4302-4311
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00152H, Paper
Xinhu Liang, Zhihao Zhang, Zhe Wang, Mingzhen Hu, Dan Cheng, Yue Jiang, Hao Ren, Fengyi Shen, Shitu Yang, Xiaoxin Yang, Wenkun Jiang, Xianghui Shi, Zihao Ma, Kebin Zhou
The oxophilic M1–Run catalysts facilely overcome the inherent scaling relationship in the alkaline hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) over traditional nanoelectrocatalysts, opening up a new opportunity to achieve maximized alkaline HER performance.
